english: Let $S$ be the set of all complex numbers $z$ satisfying $z^{5}=81\bar{z}$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{z\in S}|z-3|^{2}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$ उन सभी सम्मिश्र संख्याओं $z$ का समुच्चय है जो $z^{5}=81\bar{z}$ को संतुष्ट करती हैं। तब $\displaystyle\sum_{z\in S}|z-3|^{2}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $z=0$ is a solution. For $z\neq0$: moduli give $|z|^{5}=81|z|\Rightarrow|z|=3$
solution_full: Then $z\bar{z}=9$, so $\bar{z}=\dfrac{9}{z}$ and the equation becomes $z^{5}=\dfrac{729}{z}$, i.e. $z^{6}=729=3^{6}$. Conversely each sixth root of $729$ has modulus $3$ and satisfies the equation.
For $|z|=3$: $|z-3|^{2}=|z|^{2}-6\,\mathrm{Re}\,z+9=18-6\,\mathrm{Re}\,z$. The six roots sum to $0$, so $\sum\mathrm{Re}\,z=0$ and these contribute $6\cdot18=108$.
(Directly: the distances from $3$ are $0,3,3\sqrt{3},6,3\sqrt{3},3$, with squares $0+9+27+36+27+9=108$.)
originality_note: New: z^5 = 81 zbar gives the origin plus a regular hexagon, and the asked sum is a moment of the solution set about one of its own points, where forgetting z = 0 gives 108 (way 3). Closest known: number of solutions of z^n = zbar (known skeleton). Different because: the question is not the count but a quantity over the set, using the vanishing sum of roots; the count-type skeleton is only an ingredient.
blueprint_concepts: Equations and systems involving z and z_bar

concept_use.Equations and systems involving z and z_: z^5 = 81 zbar is solved by taking moduli (|z| = 0 or 3) and replacing zbar by 9/z.
concept_use.Equations involving complex numbers: z^6 = 729 gives the six roots 3 e^{i k pi/3}, whose sum is 0, used to add |z-3|^2 over S.

key_step: Take moduli (|z| = 0 or 3), use zbar = 9/z to get z^6 = 729, then sum 18 - 6 Re z and add z = 0.
justification: A routine chain of standard steps with one trap (z = 0); level 2, like 2023-P1-Q17 (L3) in topic but simpler.
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, locus and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that z = 0 belongs to S (the intended trap) and that S has exactly seven elements. Answer 117, positive 3-digit integer. No change.
